text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*, just as I thought. Fewer 
first-time attendees than the last live.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Was the staging too plain? Or is it brand 
recognition? Maybe a tie-in with a famous 
brand—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, that's impossible budget-wise. I don't 
have the connections anyway. Still, I have 
to figure something out...
choice_data_list: You seem to be agonizing over something.
You look like you're really troubled.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hyah! T-Trainer-san from the academy!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Well, it is tough, but I'm 
managing.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm putting real effort into my lives, and 
thoroughly promoting the best of 
Tomakomai...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's just that new fans aren't increasing 
as much as I'd hoped...

Everyoooone! Thank you all so much for 
coming todayyy!!

Looking over, Smart Falcon appeared to be 
holding a street live. Likely sponsored by 
the shopping district, shop banners were 
visible around the stage.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, isn't that a live outfit? 
And... the song seems a bit different from 
usual too...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Chock-full of meat, piping fresh and hot~♪ 
Falco's favorite, special croquettes!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Grab yours now at the butcher shop right 
at the entrance of the arcade~♪

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fans
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text:
For real, those croquettes look so good... 
Alright, I'm buying some on my way home!

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The veggie juice looks great too~! Falco 
was singing about how tasty it was, just 
like on the banner!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Resident A
text_block_list.text:
An Umadol? Is that what they call it? Just 
watching her gives you so much energy~.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Resident B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. She's working so hard to 
promote our shopping street... We've 
definitely gotta keep supporting her!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing...! Falco-san even puts on live 
shows like this...!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san!! Today's live was truly 
moving!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You got the fans interested in the 
shopping street, and helped the 
shopkeepers feel close to you, Falco-san—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was like the ultimate 'Town 
Revitalization Live'! How did you come up 
with it? What's the secret to its 
success...!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
T-Tarumae-chan? I'm happy you're excited, 
but let's take a breath, okay? Deep 
breaths~

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry...! I've just been worrying 
about my own live shows lately, so—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see. You're wondering how to bring in 
new fans, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Watching your live just now, I felt 
like there were clues to solving my 
problem...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I don't know if it'll really 
help, but I'll tell you♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was just starting out, the 
people in this shopping street invited me 
to perform at their festival!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, it wasn't a very polished 
performance... but they gave me so much 
confidence and joy...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, I wanted to give something back to the 
shopping street folks... That's what 
inspired me!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
For the people... of the shopping 
district...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see. I was in such a rush that I forgot 
what really matters.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was so focused on promoting Tomakomai 
that I completely lost sight of the people 
around me...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
People who don't know me or Tomakomai yet. 
And the people who've supported me all 
along. I have to truly connect with 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to face them properly! And I'll 
make it a live show that brings joy to 
everyone!
choice_data_list:
Looks like I don't need to worry about you 
anymore.

Looks like there's nothing to worry about 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to face them properly! And I'll 
make it a live show that brings joy to 
everyone!
choice_data_list:
Looks like I don't need to worry about you 
anymore.

Looks like there's nothing to worry about 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm♪ With how you are now, 
Tarumae-chan, you'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
! But to pull that off, I need to flesh 
out the content much more.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If I keep learning from others like I did 
today, I'm sure I can put on an even more 
wonderful live!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If I'm doing this, I'm going all the way! 
For everyone, and for Tomakomai, I refuse 
to compromise!

It seemed she had found her next goal. 
Just as she said, her next live show was 
sure to be something special.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've found my answer. All that's left 
is to charge straight ahead!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ I'm rooting for you, Tarumae-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so much! Thanks to you, I 
feel confident I can make this work.

It seemed she had cast her worries aside. 
Looking forward to her future success, I 
parted ways with Hokko Tarumae.
